verdict.rationale: Jan's API reference documents that its OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint on the local server (localhost:1337) "Supports streaming", so applications can receive tokens as they are generated using standard OpenAI-compatible clients. The streaming claim is a single line, however, with no streaming-specific detail. Missing for 10: documented streaming wire format (SSE chunk structure, stream parameter) with a streaming example, streaming behavior on the Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
